title: Paper Trail of a Cover-Up: DISB’s Internal Prep and Meeting Directives on City Lending Inc. (Feb 2021)

communications.subject: DC Freedom of Information Act Request: Paper Trail of a Cover-Up: DISB’s Internal Prep and Meeting Directives on City Lending Inc. (Feb 2021)
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the DC Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

To: claudine.sassa@dc.gov​, lilah.blackstone@dc.gov
CC: opengovoffice@dc.gov; chenderson@dccouncil.gov; lkasomo@dccouncil.gov

Subject: D.C. FOIA Request: Internal Pre-Meeting Coordination and Post-Meeting Directives (Feb 2021 - City Lending Inc.)

To the Designated FOIA Officer:

Under the District of Columbia Freedom of Information Act (D.C. Official Code § 2-531 et seq.), I am requesting records pertaining to internal executive coordination at the Department of Insurance, Securities and Banking (DISB) surrounding a regulatory oversight meeting held on February 19, 2021, regarding City Lending Inc. (NMLS: 1045126) and my FHA 203(k) mortgage dispute.

Please provide copies of the following records generated between February 1, 2021, and March 15, 2021:

1.  All internal emails, Microsoft Teams chat logs, and calendar invite descriptions sent between or among former Associate Commissioner Brian Williams, Compliance Director Philip Edmonds, Commissioner Karima Woods, and Sharon Shipp regarding the preparation for the February 19, 2021, Microsoft Teams meeting with Fred Gamble Jr.
2.  All internal memoranda, "talking points," or briefing documents circulated prior to the February 19, 2021, meeting instructing or advising Brian Williams to assert that City Lending Inc. "did nothing wrong."
3.  All internal communications, notes, or directives sent by Philip Edmonds following the February 19, 2021, meeting regarding the closure, classification, or handling of Fred Gamble Jr.'s complaint against City Lending Inc.
4.  All email communications between Brian Williams or Philip Edmonds and any representative of City Lending Inc. (including Jorge Campodonico or Indre Conners) discussing the February 19, 2021, meeting or its outcome.

Fee Waiver Request:
I request a waiver of all fees associated with this request pursuant to D.C. Official Code § 2-532(b). Disclosure is in the public interest as it will shed light on whether DISB executive leadership instructed or colluded with a former Associate Commissioner to suppress a valid consumer complaint regarding the misappropriation of federal FHA 203(k) escrow funds by a shadow lender operating in Ward 8. This request is being monitored by the D.C. Council Committee on Health (which has oversight of DISB) and federal oversight authorities.

I look forward to your response within the statutory 15 business days.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 15 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

FRED GAMBLE JR

title: lake Geneva Wisconsin missing video of meetings

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Wisconsin Open Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

**Subject: Wisconsin Public Records Request: Video/Audio of Sept. 8 Piers, Harbors and Lakefront Committee Meeting and Sept. 15 Tourism Commission Meeting**

Date: October 1, 2026

Lacey Reynolds, City Clerk
City of Lake Geneva
626 Geneva Street
Lake Geneva, WI 53147

Dear Clerk Reynolds:

Pursuant to the Wisconsin Public Records Law, Wis. Stat. §§ 19.31-19.39, I request electronic copies of the following records:

1. **All video and audio recordings of the Piers, Harbors and Lakefront Committee meeting held on September 8, 2026**, in the complete, unedited form in which they exist. The video of this meeting posted on the City's website does not play, so I am requesting the original recording file(s) rather than a link to the posted version.

2. **All video and/or audio recordings of the Tourism Commission meeting held on September 15, 2026**, in the complete, unedited form in which they exist.

**Scope.** These requests cover every recording of each meeting, regardless of format or the device or platform used to capture it. That includes the master or original video file, any separate audio recording, any backup or secondary recording, and any recording held by a third-party vendor or hosting platform on the City's behalf. If more than one version exists (for example, a raw file and an edited or compressed upload), please provide each.

**Format and delivery.** Please provide the records electronically, in their native file format, by email, secure download link, or file-transfer service. If the files are too large to email, a download link is fine. If the only existing recording of either meeting is the posted file that does not play, please tell me so in writing, and identify who holds the original.

**Fees.** I ask that fees be limited to the actual, necessary, and direct cost of reproduction as provided in Wis. Stat. § 19.35(3). Electronic delivery should involve little or no cost. 
**Response.** Wis. Stat. § 19.35(4)(a) requires a response as soon as practicable and without delay. If any part of this request is denied, please state the specific reasons in writing as required by § 19.35(4)(b), and release any portion that is not subject to the denial. If you need clarification, please contact me by email rather than delaying the response.

**Preservation.** Please preserve all recordings of both meetings, in every format, while this request is pending.

Thank you for your prompt attention.

Sincerely,

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days.

Sincerely,

Gary Milliette
